name: web_scroll
description:
web_scroll:
Scroll the page (or currently focused scroll container) using a simple direction API.

Use this instead of raw browser wheel deltas.

Arguments:
- direction: 'down' or 'up'
- amount: pixels per step
- steps: number of steps
- settle_ms: wait after each step
- capture_snapshot: include browser_snapshot after scroll

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Number of scroll steps to apply.

inputs.name: settle_ms
inputs.description: Wait time after each step in milliseconds.

inputs.name: capture_snapshot
inputs.description: If true, capture browser_snapshot after scrolling and include it in result data.

outputs.description: Structured result payload including direction and step data.
Unique id for the bundled browser_snapshot when captured.

arguments_prompt:
Fill arguments for `web_scroll`.

Return ONLY a JSON object with:
- direction ("down" | "up", default "down")
- amount (integer > 0, default 420)
- steps (integer > 0, default 1)
- settle_ms (integer >= 0, default 120)
- capture_snapshot (boolean, default true)

Example:
{"direction":"down","amount":420,"steps":2,"settle_ms":120,"capture_snapshot":true}
